summary: The register lists the Asbury site in Dale County under the Alabama Forestry Commission and says only the stands remain.

facts.status_note: Only the stands remain, according to the register.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register entry and a stub page are the only Asbury-specific sources. Two searches and the reads found no build date, design, height, staffing or fate history. The 1819 News feature is state context, not site evidence. Story kept short per the guide. Nothing read says whether the land is open to visitors.
